ns2:course.label: Evolution
ns2:course.description: Broad introduction to evolutionary biology, including natural selection and microevolution, phylogeny, speciation, molecular evolution, macroevolution and the fossil records. The laboratory emphasizes a survey of biodiversity and processes and patterns of evolution. Laboratory includes animal dissections. Credit is not given for both IB 302 and IB 201. Prerequisite: IB 204 or consent of instructor.
